text:
elena (Finance): Morning — overnight Dedicated GPU spend in us-west2 spiked ~18%. Cost UI shows most of it as UNASSIGNED. dashboard: https://billing.internal/redwood/costs?range=24h

label-bot: :warning: anomaly detected: dedicated-pool 'dedicated-large' +17.9% vs baseline. Notifying #finance #eng-platform

omar (FinOps): Pulled the billing export. A batch of instances from project trial-novus-11 have empty billing labels (team/cost_center). Quick estimate: ~$8.9k over the last 8 hours.

mina (Platform): That project used the new ephemeral onboarding path deployed last night. We missed propagating billing metadata when creating ad-hoc Dedicated instances in that flow. PR to fix is ready.

elena (Finance): Can we backfill labels so Finance can re-run attribution? We need to know whether to invoice the customer or absorb this.

leo (Sales): Trial terms say we manage infra but charge for overage beyond the 48h trial cap. I'll reach out to the customer now for written confirmation if we need to bill.

omar (FinOps): Backfill plan (dry-run first): 1) enumerate instance IDs from billing export 2) add labels via gcloud 3) trigger BigQuery re-ingest backfill. Example query/commands:
```
bq query --nouse_legacy_sql '\nSELECT resource.labels.instance_id FROM `billing_export.gcp_resource_usage` WHERE project_id="trial-novus-11" AND usage_start_time > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 12 HOUR)'\n\nfor id in $(cat instance_ids.txt); do
  gcloud compute instances add-labels $id --labels=team=novus,cost_center=trial-novus --project=trial-novus-11 --zone=us-west2-a --quiet
done
```
I need sales/legal sign-off before touching customer project metadata.

pat (Legal): Don't modify customer resources without explicit written consent unless contract allows it. Sales please attach the customer's ok to the ticket.

mina (Platform): I'll run the dry-run label command in staging and validate the ingestion backfill on a copy of the export. Once Sales posts customer confirmation, FinOps can run the actual add-labels and backfill. Also adding short-term monitor 'dedicated-unlabeled-launch' to notify #finance and the oncall rotation.

elena (Finance): Finance will hold invoicing until attribution is confirmed. If customer approves attribution, we'll draft invoice 'INV-TRIAL-NOVUS-APR' and cc Sales for approval before sending.

leo (Sales): Customer replied: "Ok to attribute trial infra to Novus for internal review. We request details and won't accept charges without prior notice." I'll paste the redacted email to the ticket and link it here.

omar (FinOps): Got the confirmation. Preparing instance list now and will run the add-labels + ingestion backfill after Legal gives final nod on wording.

pat (Legal): Redacted customer approval attached. Wording is fine to proceed with bookkeeping attribution; no immediate charge without Sales/customer agreement. FinOps can apply labels and run backfill for reporting.

label-bot: Deploy succeeded: onboarding-service label-fix v1.0.4 rolled to prod at 03:12 UTC.

elena (Finance): Thanks everyone. Leaving this thread open until the backfill completes and the invoice decision is confirmed. :white_check_mark:"
